G3.verdict: MEASURED FAIL, reported honestly, stopped as ordered without reverting or writing a prohibition
G3.bolt_diagnosis: M2 is 0.6300 at ALL widths so the fit constant is correct. M1 and M3 DRIFT by viewport. A constant rotateX cannot produce a drifting ratio, therefore the scale-dependent term is the FIXED perspective:1500px: lens distortion scales with the ratio of perspective distance to rendered size. It also pushes far rows out, inflating M3 above 1.65 and causing the negative M4 at every width. Second cause of M4: fitScene sizes to the RANK FLOOR while stands sit at 1.60x, so they stick out by construction.
